name: Sumomo Hakusho ~Anata to Itsu made mo~
original_name: すもも白書 〜あなたといつまでも～
source:
The game is mainly comprised of 2 main components, which makes up the title.

"Sumomo Hakusho" is comprised of a Adventure game component, whereas the main character is in the Art Club (Pottery dept.) preparing for the upcoming Culture and Arts Festival for the school. During that time, he can attend to school life, and in the after-school hours, he has a choice of going to different places in the school and help out different girls. Of course dating them goes next...and endings are pretty much of the standard storyline.

"Anata to Itsumademo" is a train-up game with 3 stats for the girl. When her stats rise, you'll be able to obtain CGs and H-scenes.

[from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=538&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url] ]
translation:
该游戏主要由2个主要组件组成，这两个组件构成了标题。

《相扑白书》是一款冒险游戏，主角在艺术社（陶艺系）为即将到来的学校文化艺术节做准备。在那段时间里，他可以参加学校生活，而在课余时间，他可以选择去学校的不同地方，帮助不同的女孩。当然，接下来就是与他们约会……结局几乎是标准的故事情节。

《Anata to Itsumademo》是一款女孩训练游戏，拥有3个属性。当她的属性上升时，你将能够获得CG和H场景。

[来自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=538&style=alphabetical]动漫传说[/url] ]
